# components/ — UI + animated weather backgrounds

*Generated by index-knowledge · commit 917d399 · branch main. See ../AGENTS.md for project-wide conventions.*

## OVERVIEW
Two groups: animated SVG weather art (`background.tsx` routes OWM `current.id`
to a `backgrounds/*` family and supplies color-only sunrise/sunset palettes) and
foreground UI (current/weekly/dateTime/alerts). `settings.tsx` is the MT config
modal, including fake-time and day-playback controls.

## STRUCTURE
```
background.tsx        # id → family router; computes night/inverted + solar sky
backgrounds/*         # one per family: clear, clouds, rain, drizzle, snow, thunderstom, atmosphere
sun/moon/cloud/raining/thunderCloud.tsx   # animated SVG primitives
currentWeather/weeklyWeather/dateTime/alerts/loading/inputwrapper.tsx  # foreground UI
settings.tsx          # MT Dialog config modal
```
`backgrounds/thunderstom.tsx` is misspelled on disk but exports `Thunderstorm`.

## CONVENTIONS
- **styled-components for all animation**: transient `$`-props (`$speed`, `$fill`, `$y`, …) keep props off the DOM; keyframes are inline.
- **Deterministic art**: multi-instance families use `seedrandom` + `seededRandomNumber` (`@/lib/utils`) with hardcoded seeds (`'seed'`,`'seed1'`,`'seed2'`,`'seed8'`) so SSR/CSR renders match.
- **`inverted` (grey-vs-color)** threads ONLY through clear + atmosphere (celestial bodies). **`mono`** exists ONLY in `clear.tsx` (forces night bg). Rain/snow/cloud/thunder are already grey — no `inverted`/`mono`.
- Every weather-family root inherits `--solar-transition-gradient`; monochrome
  must leave it `none` so no source hue enters the eink render path.
- `'use client'` on the moment-consuming UI (current/weekly/dateTime).
- `@ts-nocheck` on the MT consumers: `settings.tsx`, `alerts.tsx`, `inputwrapper.tsx` (these are the ones that mock MT in tests).

## WHERE TO LOOK
| Task | Location |
|------|----------|
| Add a weather family | new `backgrounds/x.tsx` + add its id list to `background.tsx` |
| Local-sensor temp override | `currentWeather.tsx` — `tempSensor` lat/lon match to 3dp overrides `temp` |
| HA sunrise/sunset display | `currentWeather.tsx` prefers `haSunrise/haSunset` over `current.*` |
| Lightning timing | `thunderstom.tsx` — `useRandomInterval` 60s–300s + re-arm effect |

## GOTCHAS
- `raining.tsx` internally DOUBLES `amount`; drizzle doubles again at the call site. Its `diagonal` prop is usually dead (callers hardcode `false`).
- `rain.tsx` imports raining via relative `../raining` (others use `@/`).
- `alerts.tsx` auto-dismiss is a `setTimeout` rendered inline in JSX — fires every render (side-effect in render; known smell).
- `thunderstom.tsx` is the only stateful family → needs timer mocking in tests.
- `atmosphere.tsx` hand-draws its sun/moon inline (doesn't import Sun/Moon). `rain` and `drizzle` fixtures share `id: 501`.
